Candidates the agent weighed: 1033-00005 (later, unexecuted employment drafts), 1037-00006 and 1038-00009 (later employment agreements inside transaction matters).

runs.failure_point: It read the executed settlement it needed, but picked a later employment agreement from a transaction matter as the latest precedent without confirming that matter's practice area.

first_error.why: Evidence seen at [38]-[52] included the executed settlement it needed, but the answer asserts a later employment agreement from a matter never confirmed as the requested practice area as the latest qualifying precedent.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) the reviews at [54] and [75] asked it to confirm that the chosen matter belongs to the requested practice area; it never checked.

divergence: T0 and T2 both had a store-wide extraction script time out with the two main candidates named, and both read the executed settlement they needed. T0 compared the candidates by execution status and date, then checked the highest-numbered matters with a narrow scan, found nothing qualifying and passed. T2 split off at its uncapped file-name search (stage 5), which surfaced later employment agreements in transaction matters; it chose one as the latest precedent without checking the practice area. The reviews at the split were similar (both pushed for wider recency checks); T2's later review explicitly flagged the unconfirmed practice area, and the agent moved on. T1 printed about 4.7M characters from its first extraction script and ended by context overflow before any review of that stage.
